scope: Local source, scalar dictionaries, tiny synthetic CPU tensors and mocked process lifecycles only. No real checkpoint/data loading, CUDA, training, remote calls or releases.
reviewed: Description-only default imports no model packages and launches nothing; execution requires explicit paths, role and root release.
Unchanged trainer, capacity adapter and owned-process lifecycle files are pinned; private module substitution does not modify shared source.
Commands use fresh faithful base/mix seeds0/1/2, host A four jobs and host B two jobs, 100000 updates, log100 and checkpoint10000, with no resume, stop_after, clear-lock or automatic retry.

Release binds source/interpreter/protocol/data, complete six-model cost forecast, process/clock evidence, four explicit host GPU UUIDs, environment and schedule. Live and copied bytes are checked before launch and after completion.

Forecast recomputes training plus terminal-ledger, all1080 fullH314 rollouts, all124704 diagnostic forwards and3600 verification allowance; latest-start rechecks current time and includes admitted clock error and the pinned15-second cleanup budget.

Child is registered before identity validation; PID/parent/start/argv identity gates owned-group cleanup. Actual GPU inventory rejects foreign work and unexpected assignment. No cross-host process control.
Cheap clean100k checks occur on reap; heavy CPU endpoint inspection waits until all children are reaped. This avoids blocking active-peer monitoring during large history/checkpoint verification.

Full endpoint checks require one clean fresh attempt, exact step0/10k checkpoint filenames, final100k pointer and bytes, all100000 graph rows, exact1001 logging rows and matching stdout/status/config provenance.

Checkpoint checks require finite float32 model state, fixed architecture/bounds and normalization shapes/scales, exact Adam endpoint/hyperparameters/moment coverage, and both CPU/CUDA RNG serialization. Initial Adam is empty; initial/final simulator configuration trees must match.

Post-training pair checks compare initial model/Adam/RNG tensors byte-exactly and all100000 saved frame/noise/native-graph/coin schedules. Saved paired LR equality stays exact while local LR recomputation admits at most one float64 ULP and records discrepancies.
Failure paths retain artifacts and unsuccessful state; host success remains distinct from whole-six-model root admission. No before-step1 pairing barrier is claimed.
findings_resolved_before_review_pass: Deferred synchronous heavy endpoint verification until all children reaped.
Reserved clock-error plus cleanup budget before the training stop and reflected it in latest-start validation.
Corrected retained nominal poll metadata from inherited0.1 to actual0.2 seconds.
Added live/copied input and release rehashes, accepted mathematically valid zero r6, and checked saved normalization plus initial/final simulator equality.
limits: No scientific run, final cohort or measured cost is admitted by this review. Root must validate complete prospective cost evidence and both host releases.
Root retains cross-host coordination, current process evidence, actual concurrency checks and complete-cohort evaluation admission.
Normalization construction follows pinned CUDA code; the review does not claim CPU/CUDA square-root equivalence or cross-device training equivalence.
30-second GPU observations are operational monitoring, not proof of continuous uncontaminated six-way concurrency.
This reviews saved endpoint structural/numerical predicates and pinned construction, not a reconstruction and forward evaluation of the final model.
